theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_scf_constancy_plane
theorems.statement: ConstancyTheorem → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (T : Grassmannian N n), C.Stationary → C.weight.support ⊆ (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) → ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ C.measure = ENNReal.ofReal θ • planeVarifoldMeasure T
